hints.title: Common Digit Priority
hints.text: If any digit appears in both arrays, the smallest single common digit forms the minimal valid number.

hints.title: Disjoint Minimum Combination
hints.text: If no digit is shared, choose the minimum digit from each array and concatenate them with the smaller digit in the tens place.

hints.title: Numeric Value Formation
hints.text: Let min1 = min(nums1) and min2 = min(nums2). Form min(min1 * 10 + min2, min2 * 10 + min1).

hints.title: Minimal Digit Construction Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs is acceptable but slower than set intersection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Checks intersection first, then minimal 2-digit combination.
